```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |> 
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Based on", scales::comma(nrow(movies)), "films"),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |> 
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0) |> 
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |> 
  group_by(genre) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) |> 
  filter(n >= 100) |> 
  arrange(mean_gap)

ggplot(movies_summary, aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Critic vs. Audience Rating Gap by Movie Genre",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate higher critic scores; negative values indicate higher audience scores",
    x = "Average Gap (Tomatometer - Audience Score)",
    y = "Genre"
  )
```

```{r}
spiderman_titles <- c(
  "Spider-Man", "Spider-Man 2", "Spider-Man 3",
  "The Amazing Spider-Man", "The Amazing Spider-Man 2",
  "Spider-Man: Homecoming", "Spider-Man: Far From Home", "Spider-Man: No Way Home"
)

spiderman <- movies |> 
  filter(title %in% spiderman_titles) |> 
  mutate(actor = case_when(
    str_detect(title, "Amazing") ~ "Andrew Garfield",
    str_detect(title, ":") ~ "Tom Holland",
    .default = "Tobey Maguire"
  )) |> 
  arrange(releaseDateTheaters)

spiderman |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(tomatoMeter, audienceScore),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    score_type = if_else(score_type == "tomatoMeter", "Tomatometer (Critics)", "Audience Score"),
    title = fct_inorder(title)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = title, y = score, color = score_type, group = score_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(40, 100)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Spider-Man Ratings Dipped Mid-Franchise Before Rebounding with Tom Holland",
    subtitle = "Scores for the eight live-action Spider-Man films in release order",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Score",
    color = "Score Type"
  )
```
